name: WidgetStack
author: brodgar
description: A WoW /framestack clone + a click-to-inspect widget inspector, and the standing harness for the W-series widget introspection (spec 20). While active it shows the live stack of widgets under the cursor in a floating window (type / #id / 'text' / WxH per level, root at top) and outlines the hovered widget with a green box; CLICK any stack row to open an Inspector window with that widget's full details (type/id/pos/size/rootpos/visible/text + a clickable parent link + a clickable child list), and inside an inspector click a child to descend or the parent to ascend -- a fully browsable widget inspector, all in pure Lua over W1/W2. It is READ-ONLY and UNGATED -- it never touches the server, it just reads the client widget tree. It exercises W2's hit-testing (hafen.ui.mouse() -> {x,y} from the cursor; hafen.ui.at(x,y) -> the DEEPEST WidgetNode a real click would hit, mirroring the engine's own pointer dispatch so it is correct under scroll offsets and non-rectangular hit areas; node:rootpos() -> the top-left in root coords for the highlight box) on top of W1's tree walk (node:parent()/:children()/:type()/:id()/:text()/:size()). The EFFICIENCY GUARD is the point: OnUpdate fires every frame, but the tree walk + window rebuild happen ONLY when the hovered widget changes -- it caches the last hovered leaf and bails early via node:same() (fresh handles + client-only leaves with no :id() make :same the only reliable identity check). A per-rebuild counter shown in the window does NOT tick while the cursor sits still. ':widgetstack' toggles the window; Ctrl+Shift+F freezes the stack so you can move the mouse into the window to read + click it. Bridge-owned -- :reload/disable tears the window + all inspector windows + the overlay + hooks down and leaks nothing (WidgetNodes are transient, not owned-registry entries, so there is nothing to grow).
